01 / About me

I’m driven by the moment a difficult idea starts to make sense.

I grew up in Semarang, Indonesia, where Olympiad mathematics first taught me to enjoy sitting with a hard problem instead of rushing toward an answer. That habit carried me through school as valedictorian of the SIS Group of Schools class of 2026.

I learn best by moving between theory and practice: building a model, questioning its assumptions, then explaining it to someone else. Through first-author research, independent software projects, teaching, and student leadership, I’ve learned that clear thinking and clear communication are inseparable. At HKU, where I hold a full-tuition scholarship, I hope to deepen both.

Quantitative Research2025

Advancing Oligopoly Pricing Predictions through Machine Learning

First-author research modelling quarterly revenue for Reliance Jio, Bharti Airtel, and Vodafone Idea using ARPU, subscriber count, and seasonal features. Benchmarked Linear Regression, Decision Tree, and Random Forest models with a 70:30 train-test split — Random Forest performed best, evaluated via MAE and MSE. Published in the Research Archive of Rising Scholars (DOI: 10.58445/rars.3120).
